improvements.message: Consider adding more advanced scoring criteria, such as sentiment analysis of chat messages or real-time audience engagement metrics, to improve scoring accuracy and relevance.
Enhance filtering capabilities by supporting multi-select filters and advanced query options (e.g., regex matching or range-based filters).
Upgrade data persistence to IndexedDB for better scalability and support for larger datasets.
Include wireframes or mockups for the GUI to provide a clearer visual representation of the design.
Expand test coverage to include edge cases, such as extremely large datasets or unusual data formats, to ensure robustness.
Add more detailed analysis of competitors' pricing models and user retention strategies to strengthen market positioning.
Include a troubleshooting section for common issues users might encounter, such as browser compatibility or data import errors.

payload.quality_target: Enhance scalability, usability, and advanced feature support.
